title: Fixed Twin-Helical-Drum Inspection Robot
description: One newly authored complete static inspection-robot appearance. Two long parallel opposite-handed drums each have a thick core, integral continuous helical crest, tapered ends and solid journals in one closed shared-vertex surface. Two whole inverted-U end-bearing arches connect the four journal end caps to a low chamfered bridge housing; a fully backed opaque front visor completes the whole robot. The centre below the bridge and the spaces between the drums and housing stay genuinely open. Six closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. New whole numerical shapes throughout: no old rover chassis with changed wheels, no old soil-auger ribbons or screw-press spindle reused, no extracted ROV body or pipe-inspector components. Opposite handed drums belong to this one prop, not two variants. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, whole horizontal envelope-centred origin with the actual lowest drum-crest vertices at ground level. Static visual genre only: no screw propulsion, rotation, traction, ground adaptation, water travel, pipe fit, sensing, autonomy, controls, working bearings, animation, load, stability, manufacture, installation, engineering or safety performance claim. No real robot construction or operating instructions.
